cards.example_en: Did you hear of that new film?
cards.example_zh: 你听说过那部新电影吗？

cards.example_en: Can you help me with the heavy bag?
cards.example_zh: 你能帮我拿这个重包吗？

cards.example_en: Help yourself to the fruit.
cards.example_zh: 请随便吃水果。

cards.example_en: Hold on, I will open the door.
cards.example_zh: 等一下，我来开门。

cards.example_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the start.
cards.example_zh: 赶快，不然我们会错过开头。

cards.example_en: Come and join in the game.
cards.example_zh: 来参加这个游戏吧。

cards.example_en: I saw him in the hall just now.
cards.example_zh: 我刚才在大厅看见他了。

cards.example_en: The rain can keep us from playing outside.
cards.example_zh: 雨会阻止我们在外面玩。

cards.example_en: Keep away from the deep water.
cards.example_zh: 远离深水区。

cards.example_en: She runs in order to keep fit.
cards.example_zh: 她跑步是为了保持健康。

cards.example_en: Keep in mind that the gate closes at six.
cards.example_zh: 记住大门六点关闭。

cards.example_en: I keep in touch with my primary teacher.
cards.example_zh: 我和小学老师保持联系。

cards.example_en: Keep off the grass, please.
cards.example_zh: 请勿践踏草坪。

cards.example_en: Keep on trying, and you will improve.
cards.example_zh: 继续尝试，你就会进步。

cards.example_en: Keep your cool if the other team scores.
cards.example_zh: 如果对方得分，保持冷静。

cards.example_en: The sign says keep out.
cards.example_zh: 牌子上写着禁止入内。

cards.example_en: Keep up the good work.
cards.example_zh: 继续保持这样好的表现。

cards.example_en: It is unkind to laugh at mistakes.
cards.example_zh: 嘲笑错误是不友善的。

cards.example_en: A small leak can lead to a big problem.
cards.example_zh: 小裂缝可能导致大问题。

cards.example_en: We can learn from our mistakes.
cards.example_zh: 我们可以从错误中学习。

cards.example_en: They leave for Nanjing tomorrow morning.
cards.example_zh: 他们明天早上动身去南京。

cards.example_en: The book costs less than fifteen yuan.
cards.example_zh: 这本书不到十五元。

cards.example_en: I will not let down my team.
cards.example_zh: 我不会让队友失望。

cards.example_en: I listen to the news every evening.
cards.example_zh: 我每天晚上听新闻。

cards.example_en: I look after my cousin on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 星期六我照顾表弟。

cards.example_en: Look ahead and plan your next step.
cards.example_zh: 向前看，计划下一步。

cards.example_en: We look around the old market every spring.
cards.example_zh: 每年春天我们在旧市场里四处看看。

cards.example_en: Look at the board, please.
cards.example_zh: 请看黑板。

cards.example_en: I look back on that trip with a smile.
cards.example_zh: 我微笑着回顾那次旅行。

cards.example_en: Never look down on a beginner.
cards.example_zh: 永远不要看不起初学者。

cards.example_en: I look for my blue pen every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我每天早上寻找我的蓝笔。

cards.example_en: I look forward to the winter holiday.
cards.example_zh: 我期待寒假。

cards.example_en: The school will look into the broken window.
cards.example_zh: 学校会调查打破的窗户。

cards.example_en: You look like your mother.
cards.example_zh: 你看起来像你妈妈。

cards.example_en: Look out! A bike is coming.
cards.example_zh: 留神！有辆自行车过来了。

cards.example_en: The nurse will look over his arm.
cards.example_zh: 护士会检查他的胳膊。

cards.example_en: I look through the paper before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭前我浏览报纸。

cards.example_en: Look up the word in a dictionary.
cards.example_zh: 在词典里查阅这个词。

cards.example_en: Many students look up to the coach.
cards.example_zh: 许多学生尊敬这位教练。

cards.example_en: We try to make guests feel at home.
cards.example_zh: 我们尽量让客人感到自在。

cards.example_en: Students can make a contribution to the school garden.
cards.example_zh: 学生可以为学校花园做贡献。

cards.example_en: We need to make a decision before Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们需要在星期五前做决定。

cards.example_en: A kind word can make a difference.
cards.example_zh: 一句善意的话也能有影响。

cards.example_en: The baby will make a face at the camera.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝会对着相机做鬼脸。

cards.example_en: He can make a living by teaching music.
cards.example_zh: 他可以靠教音乐谋生。

cards.example_en: Do not make a noise in the reading room.
cards.example_zh: 阅览室里不要发出噪音。

cards.example_en: Let us make a plan for the trip.
cards.example_zh: 我们来为旅行制定计划。
